guides.intro: What an Enhancement shaman presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. Enhancement is the shaman's fastest leveling spec in the fight lab: you walk in, swing a slow weapon, and add a shock and a strike on short cooldowns. Mana goes to shocks, not to Lightning Bolts. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Swing
stages.change: Your weapon and **Rockbiter Weapon** do the work.
press: One **Lightning Bolt** while the mob runs at you, if you like. Mana is no worry yet.
Then swing until it is dead.
notes: Keep **Rockbiter Weapon** on your weapon at all times. Recast it when it runs out.
Heal with **Healing Wave** between fights.

stages.title: Earth Shock
stages.change: **Earth Shock**, an instant on a short cooldown. From here on, skip the opening Lightning Bolt.
press: Walk in and swing. No opening Lightning Bolt: its mana costs more drinking than the damage saves.
**Earth Shock** whenever it is ready.
notes: **Earth Shock** also interrupts. Use it on a caster's spell and the mob walks to you.
**Stoneskin Totem** (4) and **Earthbind Totem** (6) are not part of a fight against one mob.

stages.title: Lightning Shield
stages.change: **Lightning Shield** on yourself: mobs that hit you take damage. **Stoneclaw Totem** is your first panic button.
press: **Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Earth Shock** whenever it is ready.
stages.if_hurt: Under 30% of your health: drop **Stoneclaw Totem**. The mob turns on the totem while you cast **Healing Wave**.

stages.title: Searing Totem, and talents begin
stages.change: **Searing Totem** at the pull adds free damage for the whole fight. Talent points start.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Earth Shock** whenever it is ready.
stages.if_hurt: Under 30% of your health: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** and cast **Healing Wave**.
notes: **Flame Shock** (10) shares its cooldown with **Earth Shock**. Against one mob the fight lab never casts it.
Stay on **Rockbiter Weapon** until level 30. **Flametongue Weapon** (10) is not the leveling imbue.
Use a slow two-handed weapon as soon as you can: every strike and proc scales with the weapon's hit.
**Strength of Earth Totem** (10) and **Fire Nova** (12) cost more mana than they return against one mob.

stages.title: Lesser Healing Wave and Ghost Wolf
stages.change: Nothing new in the fight. **Lesser Healing Wave** is a fast heal, **Ghost Wolf** gets you between mobs sooner.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Earth Shock** whenever it is ready.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: **Ghost Wolf** (20) between pulls and on every walk back from the graveyard.
**Frost Shock** (20) is for a mob that runs away, or to slow one you want to escape. It shares the shock cooldown.

stages.title: Stormstrike
stages.change: **Stormstrike** (talent): an instant weapon strike that also makes your next shocks hit 20% harder.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Stormstrike** whenever it is ready.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free. Cast after a **Stormstrike**, it takes the 20% bonus.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: **Flurry** (26-29, 32) makes you swing faster after every critical hit. Nothing to press.

stages.title: Windfury Weapon
stages.change: **Windfury Weapon** replaces Rockbiter on your weapon: a chance on every hit for extra swings.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Stormstrike** whenever it is ready.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: Put **Windfury Weapon** on your weapon the moment you train it, and keep it there to 60.
**Chain Lightning** (32) and **Windfury Totem** (32) are not part of a fight against one mob.

stages.title: Maelstrom Weapon
stages.change: **Maelstrom Weapon** (talent): your hits build stacks, and at 5 your **Lightning Bolt** is instant.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
With 5 stacks of **Maelstrom Weapon**: an instant **Lightning Bolt**, once the mob is under 35% of its health.
**Stormstrike** whenever it is ready.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: The stacks come faster with every point of **Maelstrom Weapon** (35-39). Never cast **Lightning Bolt** with its cast time.
Do not spend the instant bolt on a mob it would overkill.

stages.title: Rage of the Farseer, the finished rotation
stages.change: **Rage of the Farseer** (talent) opens a fight whenever it is ready. Nothing else new: buy every new rank.
press: **Rage of the Farseer** at the start of a fight whenever it is ready.
**Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
With 5 stacks of **Maelstrom Weapon**: an instant **Lightning Bolt**, once the mob is under 35% of its health.
**Stormstrike** whenever it is ready.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: The remaining points go to Elemental for cheaper, harder shocks: **Convection** (52-56) and **Concussion** (47-51).

between: Heal back to about 80% of your health with **Lesser Healing Wave** from level 20, or **Healing Wave** for a big gap and before 20.
Eat if you are still under 80% and out of mana for heals. Drink only below about 15% of your mana.
Recast your weapon imbue when it runs out, and **Lightning Shield** before each pull.
Visit the trainer every even level for new ranks of **Earth Shock** and **Lightning Shield**.
other: Elemental is about 16% slower per kill in the fight lab. It plays **Lightning Bolt** from range and is on its own page in this folder.
A shaman who wants to heal at 60 levels fastest as Enhancement and respecs, or levels into the Restoration build shown on its page.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; buffs, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme is the same on every class: Q the attack you press most, E the control, R the payoff, F the escape or the save, the thumb buttons the reactions, 1-4 the rest, the Shift bar the wider or rarer version of the key under it. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup: the [shaman keybinds page](keybinds.md).

slots.role: Your shock, pressed most; the macro also starts your swings
Control: slow a mob that runs or that you leave
The payoff: your strike, then the shock hits harder
The save: mobs turn on the totem while you heal
Thumb reaction: eat a caster's spell
The instant bolt at 5 Maelstrom stacks (an opener at 1-3 if you like)
The big heal, in a stun or behind the totem

bars.title: Action bar 2: the same keys with Shift

slots.role: Packs: the fire shock to spread
Packs: the blast around your Fire totem (drop Searing Totem first)
Your healing potion (macro on the macro page)
Your mana potion (macro on the macro page)

notes: Two swaps on bar 1: **Lesser Healing Wave** takes the thumb at 20 and **Healing Wave** moves to C as the big heal.

**Lightning Shield** and your weapon imbue (**Rockbiter Weapon**, **Windfury Weapon** from 30) are buffs: click them between fights. The fight lab puts the shield back before a pull, about every second kill, and never in the fight.

No key: **Lightning Shield**, the weapon imbue, **Ghost Wolf**, food, water, the mount and the Hearthstone. **Strength of Earth Totem** and the other buff totems cost more than they return against one mob.
Right-click the mob to start swinging at levels 1-3. From 4, Q is a macro on the [keybinds page](keybinds.md) that also starts your swings, so the middle mouse button stays free.
The single-target rotation never casts **Flame Shock**, **Fire Nova**, **Chain Lightning** or **Magma Totem**. They are there for a pull that brings friends.

guides.intro: What an Elemental shaman presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. Elemental fights from range: **Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, then the shocks on their shared cooldown, more bolts between them while your mana holds, and your weapon swinging in every gap. Mana is the limit, so the list always keeps enough for the next shock. The build's first points go to Restoration and Enhancement for hit, mana and crit; the Elemental talents start at 29. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Lightning Bolt
stages.change: **Lightning Bolt** is your attack: from range as the mob walks in, and again in melee while your mana lasts.
press: **Lightning Bolt** from as far as it reaches, and again while the mob walks in.
In melee, **Lightning Bolt** again while you have the mana; then let your weapon swing until the mob is dead.
notes: Keep **Rockbiter Weapon** on your weapon. Your swings fill every gap between casts, from here to 60.
Right-click the mob once it reaches you, so your weapon swings between casts.
Heal with **Healing Wave** between fights.

stages.title: Earth Shock
stages.change: **Earth Shock**, an instant on a short cooldown. It also interrupts a caster.
press: **Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.
In melee: **Earth Shock** whenever it is ready, first of all when it would kill the mob.
**Lightning Bolt** between shocks while you keep the mana for the next **Earth Shock**; otherwise let your weapon swing. Skip it on a mob your next swing or shock will finish.
notes: In melee the bolts now stop where your mana would no longer cover the next **Earth Shock**: the shock is instant, and a mob's hits cannot push it back.
**Stoneskin Totem** (4) and **Earthbind Totem** (6) are not part of a fight against one mob.

stages.title: Lightning Shield
stages.change: **Lightning Shield** on yourself: mobs that hit you take damage. **Stoneclaw Totem** is your first panic button.
press: **Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.
In melee: **Earth Shock** whenever it is ready, first of all when it would kill the mob.
**Lightning Bolt** between shocks while you keep the mana for the next **Earth Shock**; otherwise let your weapon swing. Skip it on a mob your next swing or shock will finish.
stages.if_hurt: Under 30% of your health: drop **Stoneclaw Totem**. The mob turns on the totem while you cast **Healing Wave**.

stages.title: Flame Shock and Searing Totem, and talents begin
stages.change: **Flame Shock** burns the mob over time and **Searing Totem** shoots it from the pull. Talent points start.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.
In melee: **Earth Shock** when it would kill the mob.
**Flame Shock** while it is not on the mob and the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
**Lightning Bolt** between shocks while you keep the mana for the next **Earth Shock** and **Flame Shock**; otherwise let your weapon swing. Skip it on a mob your next swing or shock will finish.
stages.if_hurt: Under 30% of your health: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** and cast **Healing Wave**.
notes: The shocks share one cooldown: **Flame Shock** takes it while it is not ticking, **Earth Shock** every other time.
The first points go to Restoration: **Tidal Focus** (10-14) for 5% more chance to hit, **Mindfulness** (15-17) to keep half your mana regeneration going while you cast.
Stay on **Rockbiter Weapon** until level 30. **Flametongue Weapon** (10) is not the leveling imbue.
**Strength of Earth Totem** (10), **Fire Nova** (12) and **Purge** (12) are not part of a fight against one mob.

stages.title: Lesser Healing Wave and Frost Shock
stages.change: Nothing new in the fight. **Lesser Healing Wave** is a fast heal, **Ghost Wolf** gets you between mobs sooner.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.

**Flame Shock** while it is not on the mob and the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
**Lightning Bolt** between shocks while you keep the mana for the next **Earth Shock** and **Flame Shock**; otherwise let your weapon swing. Skip it on a mob your next swing or shock will finish.

notes: **Ghost Wolf** (20) between pulls and on every walk back from the graveyard.
**Frost Shock** (20) is for a mob that runs away, or to slow one you want to escape. It shares the shock cooldown.

The points of 18-28 go to Enhancement: **Thundering Strikes** for crit with spells and swings, **Ancestral Knowledge** for more Intellect and **Mental Dexterity**, which turns Intellect into attack power for your weapon.

stages.title: Shamanistic Focus, then the Elemental tree
stages.change: **Shamanistic Focus** (talent) makes your shocks and **Lightning Shield** 45% cheaper. From 29, **Convection** cuts the cost of shocks and bolts.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.

**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.

notes: Cheaper shocks mean more bolts between them: the list does not change, your mana lasts longer.
Put **Windfury Weapon** (30) on your weapon the moment you train it, and keep it there to 60.
**Grounding Totem** (30) eats a caster mob's next spell.
**Chain Lightning** (32) and **Windfury Totem** (32) are not part of a fight against one mob.

stages.title: Elemental Alacrity: faster bolts
stages.change: **Elemental Alacrity** (talent) takes up to half a second off **Lightning Bolt**'s cast: more bolts fit in while the mob walks in.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.
In melee: **Earth Shock** when it would kill the mob.
**Flame Shock** while it is not on the mob and the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.

notes: **Call of Flame** (37-38, 60) makes **Flame Shock** and **Searing Totem** hit harder and **Flame Shock** last longer.
**Elemental Focus** (39): after a damage spell, sometimes the next one is free. Nothing to press: the next spell in the list takes it.
**Concussion** (40-43): your bolts and **Earth Shock** hit harder.

stages.title: Eye of the Storm, the finished rotation
stages.change: **Eye of the Storm** (talent): at 3 points (46), 70% of a mob's hits no longer push your **Lightning Bolt** back. Nothing else new in the fight: buy every new rank.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.
In melee: **Earth Shock** when it would kill the mob.
**Flame Shock** while it is not on the mob and the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
**Lightning Bolt** between shocks while you keep the mana for the next **Earth Shock** and **Flame Shock**; otherwise let your weapon swing. Skip it on a mob your next swing or shock will finish.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: **Reverberation** (47-48, 53) shortens the shock cooldown.
**Call of Thunder** (49), **Lightning Overload** (50-52) and **Elemental Fury** (54-58): more bolt crits, a free second bolt now and then, and bigger crits. Nothing to press.
**Elemental Reach** (59) adds range to **Lightning Bolt**: start the pull a little farther out. **Call of Flame** (60) takes its third rank: **Flame Shock** and **Searing Totem** hit a little harder.

between: Heal back to about 80% of your health with **Lesser Healing Wave** from level 20, or **Healing Wave** for a big gap and before 20.
Eat if you are still under 80% and out of mana for heals. Drink only below about 15% of your mana.
Recast your weapon imbue when it runs out, and **Lightning Shield** before each pull.
Visit the trainer every even level for new ranks of **Lightning Bolt**, **Earth Shock**, **Flame Shock** and your heals.

**Lightning Shield** and **Water Shield** are buffs, like your weapon imbue (**Rockbiter Weapon**, **Windfury Weapon** from 30): click them between fights. No key either: **Ghost Wolf**, food, water, the mount and the Hearthstone.

guides.intro: What an Elemental-Enhancement shaman presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. The hybrid plays the Elemental list: **Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, then the shocks on their shared cooldown, more bolts between them while your mana holds, and your weapon swinging in every gap. Its talents swap trees in blocks: Elemental first for cheaper, faster bolts (10-20), then hit from Restoration (21-23), Enhancement for crit and Intellect (25-35), Elemental again for the deep bolt talents (36-47), and Enhancement for most of the last points. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Lightning Bolt
stages.change: **Lightning Bolt** is your attack: from range as the mob walks in, and again in melee while your mana lasts.
press: **Lightning Bolt** from as far as it reaches, and again while the mob walks in.
In melee, **Lightning Bolt** again while you have the mana; then let your weapon swing until the mob is dead.
notes: Keep **Rockbiter Weapon** on your weapon. Your swings fill every gap between casts, from here to 60.
Right-click the mob once it reaches you, so your weapon swings between casts.
Heal with **Healing Wave** between fights.

stages.title: Earth Shock
stages.change: **Earth Shock**, an instant on a short cooldown. It also interrupts a caster.
press: **Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.
In melee: **Earth Shock** whenever it is ready, first of all when it would kill the mob.
**Lightning Bolt** between shocks while you keep the mana for the next **Earth Shock**; otherwise let your weapon swing. Skip it on a mob your next swing or shock will finish.
notes: In melee the bolts now stop where your mana would no longer cover the next **Earth Shock**: the shock is instant, and a mob's hits cannot push it back.
**Stoneskin Totem** (4) and **Earthbind Totem** (6) are not part of a fight against one mob.

stages.title: Lightning Shield
stages.change: **Lightning Shield** on yourself: mobs that hit you take damage. **Stoneclaw Totem** is your first panic button.
press: **Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.
In melee: **Earth Shock** whenever it is ready, first of all when it would kill the mob.
**Lightning Bolt** between shocks while you keep the mana for the next **Earth Shock**; otherwise let your weapon swing. Skip it on a mob your next swing or shock will finish.
stages.if_hurt: Under 30% of your health: drop **Stoneclaw Totem**. The mob turns on the totem while you cast **Healing Wave**.

stages.title: Flame Shock and Searing Totem, and talents begin
stages.change: **Flame Shock** burns the mob over time and **Searing Totem** shoots it from the pull. Talent points start, in Elemental.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.
In melee: **Earth Shock** when it would kill the mob.
**Flame Shock** while it is not on the mob and the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
**Lightning Bolt** between shocks while you keep the mana for the next **Earth Shock** and **Flame Shock**; otherwise let your weapon swing. Skip it on a mob your next swing or shock will finish.
stages.if_hurt: Under 30% of your health: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** and cast **Healing Wave**.
notes: The shocks share one cooldown: **Flame Shock** takes it while it is not ticking, **Earth Shock** every other time.

**Convection** (10-14) makes shocks and bolts cheaper; **Elemental Alacrity** (15-17) takes up to half a second off **Lightning Bolt**'s cast; **Call of Flame** (18-19) makes **Flame Shock** and **Searing Totem** hit harder.
Stay on **Rockbiter Weapon** until level 30. **Flametongue Weapon** (10) is not the leveling imbue.
**Strength of Earth Totem** (10), **Fire Nova** (12) and **Purge** (12) are not part of a fight against one mob.

stages.title: Lesser Healing Wave and Frost Shock
stages.change: Nothing new in the fight. **Lesser Healing Wave** is a fast heal, **Ghost Wolf** gets you between mobs sooner.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.
In melee: **Earth Shock** when it would kill the mob.
**Flame Shock** while it is not on the mob and the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
**Lightning Bolt** between shocks while you keep the mana for the next **Earth Shock** and **Flame Shock**; otherwise let your weapon swing. Skip it on a mob your next swing or shock will finish.
stages.if_hurt: Under 40% of your health: **Lesser Healing Wave**. Under 30%: drop **Stoneclaw Totem** first.
notes: **Ghost Wolf** (20) between pulls and on every walk back from the graveyard.
**Frost Shock** (20) is for a mob that runs away, or to slow one you want to escape. It shares the shock cooldown.
**Elemental Focus** (20): after a damage spell, sometimes the next one is free. Nothing to press: the next spell in the list takes it.
**Tidal Focus** (21-23) for more chance to hit, then **Thundering Strikes** (25-29) for crit with spells and swings.

stages.title: Windfury Weapon
stages.change: **Windfury Weapon** replaces Rockbiter on your weapon. **Mental Dexterity** (talent) turns your Intellect into attack power for its swings, and **Ancestral Knowledge** raises that Intellect.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.
In melee: **Earth Shock** when it would kill the mob.
**Flame Shock** while it is not on the mob and the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.

notes: Put **Windfury Weapon** on your weapon the moment you train it, and keep it there to 60.
**Grounding Totem** (30) eats a caster mob's next spell.
**Chain Lightning** (32) and **Windfury Totem** (32) are not part of a fight against one mob.

stages.title: Shamanistic Focus
stages.change: **Shamanistic Focus** (talent) makes your shocks and **Lightning Shield** 45% cheaper: more bolts between the shocks.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.

notes: **Concussion** (36-37): your bolts and **Earth Shock** hit harder. **Reverberation** (38) shortens the shock cooldown.

stages.title: Eye of the Storm, the finished rotation
stages.change: **Eye of the Storm** (talent): at 3 points (41), 70% of a mob's hits no longer push your **Lightning Bolt** back. Nothing else new in the fight: buy every new rank.
press: **Searing Totem** as you pull, while you have more than half your mana.
**Lightning Shield** up before the pull.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you. The first one from as far as it reaches.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts, and the mob walks to you.

From 48 the points go back to Enhancement: **Mental Dexterity** (48-49), **Improved Lightning Shield** (50-51, 56), **Toughness** (52-55) for health and **Mental Quickness** (57-58) for spell damage from your Intellect.
**Elemental Reach** (59) adds range to **Lightning Bolt**: start the pull a little farther out. **Elemental Fury** (60) makes your crits bigger.

Enhancement is the shaman's fastest leveling spec in the fight lab. It fights in melee with **Stormstrike** and is on its own page in this folder.
